newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sum Cheong gets S$80 mln revolving credit.
newsitem.headline: Sum Cheong gets S$80 mln revolving credit.

text.p: Sum Cheong group of companies said on Monday it had obtained a Singapore $80 million revolving credit facility arranged by Dresdner (South East Asia) Ltd.
Sum Cheong said in a statement the credit line was made up of a S$30 million syndicated revolving advance facility and a S$50 million bilateral revolving trade/guarantee facility.
A total of eight banks and one financial institution from Asia and Europe participated in the credit facility including Dresdner Bank AG, it said.
The group receiving the credit line comprised Sum Cheong Piling Pte Ltd, Sum Cheong Machinery Pte Ltd, SC-Marine Pte Ltd and RB Machinery (Far East) Pte Ltd.
